title: RPZ vs PVB: compare the protection method before comparing the price
description: A plain-language comparison of reduced-pressure-zone assemblies and pressure vacuum breakers for people who need to identify the decision owner and next verification step.
prompt: What governing requirement and installation condition decide between an RPZ and PVB?
answer: RPZ and PVB are distinct device families with different operating and installation constraints. The actual hazard, system use, local requirement, and approved assembly rule decide—not a generic comparison or device price.
urgency: Do not substitute one family for the other without authority approval and a qualified installation scope.
diagramAlt: Reduced pressure zone backflow assembly for comparison planning
aliases: reduced pressure zone vs pressure vacuum breaker
